findings.summary: An isolation check that raises (failure path) does not update or invalidate _isolation_results, so a later successful re-check of the other role is summarised with a stale or missing result for this role.
findings.scenario: Start-up check raises unexpectedly (failure set, _isolation_results stays {}), UI shows 'failed'; manager is restarted and its re-check succeeds -> _isolation_summary() = summarize_isolation({manager: ok}) -> state 'ok' although worker was never verified. Likewise a failed manager re-check followed by a worker restart reports manager's pre-restart result. check_isolation normally returns an error dict instead of raising, so this needs an unexpected exception.
findings.suggestion: On failure record an error entry for each role in checks (e.g. results[role] = {'state':'failed','error':failure}) and update _isolation_results with it.

findings.summary: While one role is re-checked the whole omp_isolation summary is 'pending' with empty top-level leaks/warning, so a known leak/warning of the other role is not shown in the header until the re-check ends.
findings.scenario: Worker start-up check reported 'leak'; user restarts manager -> for up to ISOLATION_CHECK_TIMEOUT the snapshot/record show state pending, leaks [] (worker leak only inside roles{}), header warning disappears, then returns. Bounded and self-healing; disclosure-level only.
findings.suggestion: Keep the other roles' leaks/warnings at top level while pending (or a 'pending+leak' presentation).

findings.summary: Restart runs old.close() synchronously on the UI loop: remaining members of the exited OMP's session (e.g. a nohup'd job the OMP's bash tool left running) are SIGKILLed at Enter, and the loop can block up to ~2 s while they die.
findings.scenario: Worker OMP started 'nohup long_experiment &' via its bash tool, then the user exits OMP with Ctrl-d Ctrl-d and presses Enter -> the experiment process (same session, pinned at reap) is killed by _kill_owned_session; other panes' output is not pumped during the kill window. Same ownership rule as shutdown (C-D45) and tested intentionally (p27q 'in-session helper killed'), but the exited-pane notice does not tell the user that pressing Enter ends leftovers of the old OMP.
findings.suggestion: Record as accepted behaviour (or mention in the notice/help) rather than change code now.

findings.summary: Inside tmux the copy only reaches the clipboard with set-clipboard on or allow-passthrough on; tmux defaults (set-clipboard external, allow-passthrough off) drop it.
findings.scenario: A user with a default ~/.tmux.conf drags text: footer says '복사됨' plus the hint, nothing reaches the clipboard. The requesting user's tmux has both options on (assignment-p27-copy-worker-01), live probe case C confirms the hint; so C-D62 is met for this user, but the requirement is conditional on tmux options and should be stated in docs/help.
findings.suggestion: Note the tmux option dependency in CW-06 evidence/SPEC; no code change needed.
